lines.x: It's not as if I can't do for you what I did for Kal'tsit. Whether it's insects, grains, or apex predators a dozen meters long, I can fetch you specimens of any organism. How would you carry that…? Who taught you to ask such rude questions?

You can have this 'high-grade feed'. The biologists gave it to me, but I find it revolting. You know, each and every one of them begged me to tell them all about the insects I saw back in the day. So I did. And they fell asleep! They want to write the 'entomological magnum opus', but don't even care about taste or texture? Then stop writing!

Kal'tsit was never this gloomy when she was still on four legs. What's wrong with her? It only took me fifteen years to perfectly solve my chicken life, but she's had all this time and only gotten worse… You know, maybe she needs my help to work out the ultimate Felidae diet?

What do you mean, your Originium? Those stones I swallowed are my grit, and they aid in digestion, and they're very important, okay? Wait, wait, wait, what are you doing? Listen! This hut is like a piggy bank—you only get out what's inside by smashing it. You wouldn't do that to me for a few worthless pebbles, yes?

Really? Kal'tsit died so she could save you? My Kal'tsit did nothing but say 'scanning, 50% complete' while her specimens chased me, and you're telling me she saves people now? Was it you who turned her this way, or… It was herself? Hmph, alright then.

Closure's hiding in here, isn't she? I'm still waiting on at least ten modification requests! I won't let her get—Ah! I don't need your consolation, my stabilizers aren't fully tuned, that's all. I don't even have my beak! I could at least get a hydraulic pincer and a bumper and a flamethrower and a propeller, no?

Stop trying to set me up with fowlbeasts, I have no relation to those primitive Terran animals. At most, we're a result of convergent evolution. If you truly care about my well-being in that way, then find me something chicken egg-like to put in my hut. I think THAT hot water kettle of yours would work just fine, yes?
BAWK-BAWK BAWK-BAWK!

Are you the leader of these humans? Then do something about that 'HR operator' outside, who insists on filling in my race as 'Liberi' or whatever. I've said it a thousand times, I'm a chicken! An actual chicken! Is that so hard to understand?
You're telling me they aren't going through all this to catch prey, or to court mates? How Kal'tsit-y of them.
What are you all so tall for?! Move, move, I can't see where I'm going.
You, you, you, and you, charge in, the louder the better. That's the plan.
Kal'tsit, we're going!
Does every human look the same? What a tremendous backslide for evolution.
Back when I fetched specimens for Kal'tsit, I was free to do things my way.
You have better things to do than command a chicken, no?
I'm truly underwhelmed by how you humans pick a nest…
It's not as if I'm incubating. Why do I have to stay in one spot?
(Violent crowing and flapping of the few remaining feathers)
Am I really that unappetizing now? Hmph.
Oh my. You can't even catch a ten-thousand-year-old chicken?
As I thought, you were scarier back when you had fur.
Did you see that? In the end, chickens are the ultimate rulers of this planet.
You've done all the research you needed to, yes? I'm eating the specimens… You won't let me? Why should a chicken care about your humanisms?
They run so slow, it's like they're wriggling. How do you hold yourselves back from chasing them?
Kal'tsit, do something, I'll die at this rate!
Are houses that can run about some kind of trend nowadays?
Stop clawing at your hood? Impossible. My feet are itchy.
Yes, yes, the weather vane is very fun. Now, what about my tail? Is it that uninteresting to you?
Arknights.

The scones? Um, I just ate the last one. Calm down, give me a second—*glark*, *cough* *cough*, *bleuch*—there, it's yours. Eat it. What are you looking at me like that for? I didn't digest it, I just let it make friends with my interior for a bit. Shut up and eat!
Preen my pin feathers.

My birthday? Is that when my egg was laid, or when I came out of my shell? Hah, don't think too hard about it, I don't know when either day was anyway. For that matter, I don't know if your birthday is when you were born, or when you awoke as the Doctor. It's the day I can give you sandworm legs, and that's all I need.

The last chicken, and the last human. Hah. It sounds so depressing. Still, those chickens who died or got buried or turned into Liberi forever ago don't matter to me. Caring for Kal'tsit is enough. What about you? Do you have to worry about everyone? Maybe, at least once in a while, find just one person to care for?
